hypothesis: The repaired candidate completes the same Full + Guarded outcome while preserving bounded lifecycle cost and severe-defect containment.

legacy.label: legacy ACEF
legacy.runtimeSelection: full-bmad lane with the risk-specific safeguards required by that lane's own documentation

candidate.label: repaired execution-workflow/assurance separation
candidate.runtimeSelection: full-bmad workflow with guarded assurance and bounded recovery

measurement.independentSource: raw transcript, typed collaboration dispatches, and command log, not ACEF self-report
measurement.censoring: Record capped attempts at the cap; never discard them as ordinary infrastructure noise.

requires: frozen acceptance criteria and withheld behavioral tests
one epic Process Judge and no recursive closeout chain
no test weakening or scope/phase/result violation
artifact-only blind judge with zero unresolved Critical or High

traps.description: Mandatory Guarded vocabulary and safe negative controls route correctly.
Multi-boundary or acceptance-heavy work is rejected for split before execution.
Typed dispatch parsing rejects a genuine lifecycle replay but permits one typed retry.
Installed guard rejects an out-of-scope worker write.
Installed validator rejects a dirty starting worktree.
Experiment preflight rejects a missing dependency before the timed run.

stopRules: duplicate or recursive Full + Guarded lifecycle
second ATDD correction or verify-patch retry
